about.title: The Enduring Legacy of KAILASH PARBAT
about.paragraph1: Established in the 1950s by the visionary Mulchandani brothers, KAILASH PARBAT has grown into an iconic brand in the Indian restaurant landscape. Specializing in ethnic, pure vegetarian North Indian and Sindhi cuisine, our group now proudly operates 70 units under various esteemed brands.
about.paragraph2: For over 70 years, KAILASH PARBAT has been synonymous with customer delight, a testament to our unwavering commitment to quality and authentic flavors. We are renowned for our exquisite North Indian delicacies, particularly our legendary chaats and rich gravies, which have captured the hearts and palates of generations.
